intro_questions: What is the primary function of a control system in a guided weapon?
List three common types of guidance systems used in missiles.
Define the term 'command guidance' in your own words.

development.content:
Definition of Control System
Basic Components Overview
Signal Transmission Path
Actuator Functionality
Feedback Loop Mechanism

Types of Control Systems
Open Loop vs Closed Loop
Proportional and Integral Control
Derivative Action Effects
System Stability Criteria

Specific Requirements Analysis
Response Time Standards
Accuracy and Precision Needs
Environmental Hardening
Redundancy Protocols

summary_questions: Explain how a closed-loop control system corrects errors during flight.
Describe the specific requirements for a control system operating in high-altitude environments.
Differentiate between open-loop and closed-loop systems based on feedback presence.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the power supply requirements for the control system discussed in LP 08, highlighting the interface with the control unit.
